content: nu .fabro/scripts/push-gate.nu && but push main — never pipe the gate (a piped exit code is the pipe member's; fabro 2026-10-02 incident). Fresh-repo bootstrap needed a one-time git root-commit push because gitbutler requires an origin HEAD before but setup can set its target; all content commits go through but.
NEVER run seeds sync or ml sync in this repo under GitButler; commit .seeds/ and .mulch/ changes explicitly via but commit in the same batch as the code change (fabro iterate precedent).

nu .fabro/scripts/push-gate.nu && but push <branch> — never pipe the gate (a piped exit code is the pipe member's; fabro 2026-10-02 incident). PR leg until forge auth: gh pr create + gh pr merge --auto --squash (fabro precedent). Local landing NEVER pushes main directly; the workspace follows origin/main with but pull.

nu .fabro/scripts/push-gate.nu && but push <branch> — never pipe the gate (a piped exit code is the pipe member's; fabro 2026-10-02 incident). Landing: but push + but pr new + but pr auto-merge into main (forge auth valid since 2026-10-03; gh was the interim leg). The workspace follows origin/main with but pull.

description: but pr auto-merge engages auto-merge with merge-method MERGE; main requires linear history — the merge never lands.
resolution: After but pr auto-merge <sel>, ALWAYS re-arm with gh pr merge <n> --auto --squash (PR #3 lesson 2026-10-03: auto-merge enabled at MERGE and stalled silently until re-armed with squash). Recorded in AGENTS.md landing-work bullet.

title: Local iterate sprint system (nu-agent port, but-based, fabro-independent)
rationale: User directive 2026-10-03: work locally for now; same sprint system as nu-agent; the sprint system is independent of the fabro develop line; use but instead of git; delegate worthwhile tasks to subagents.

description: The ml-ref-prober report cited byte sizes (1395/4230) that did not match the actual artifacts (1421/4322) — always pin parity templates from the BYTES (snapshots/files), never from a report transcript; the differential battery against the live reference is the real gate. Resolution: fixtures copied byte-identically from the probe workdir, verified against both snapshots.
resolution: Trust bytes over prose; verify via live differential runs.

title: Architecture gate @ sprint 3: five deepening candidates
rationale: Deepening pays off where the remaining ~20 parity commands each touch the same store; the gate ran after the third sprint as the loop requires.

description: Sprint 4 (mulch-8204): while moving the strict reader behind a lib seam, the first cut dropped the CLI flag that the old call sites passed (`--allow-unknown-types`), so three commands accepted the flag and silently ignored it — a regression the 65-test battery could not see (no test exercised the flag on those commands).
resolution: read_records(domain, allow_unknown) takes the flag explicitly; before/after call-site diff of every flag that reaches a moved function. LESSON: when a function moves behind a seam, diff the ARGUMENTS of every call site, not just the behaviour of the new path.
